messages:
maria: Pushed a small docs PR to clarify quantized variant support for stratus6b, add a client-side detection snippet, and fix two broken links. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/507

kevin: Nice. Can you specify which CUDA/kernel versions cause CPU fallback? That detail helps infra and Dedicated customers.

maria: Added a compatibility note: older CUDA runtimes (<=530) and kernels without int4 optimizations may trigger server-side CPU fallback for some quant variants. Linked runtime compat doc.

ara: Please include a minimal SDK snippet to show how to surface the runtime so users can detect fallback in their apps. Keep it tiny.

maria: Snippet added:
```
from redwood import Client
c = Client()
r = c.generate("short summary", model="stratus6b:quant-int4")
print(r.text)
print("runtime:", getattr(r, "runtime", "unknown"))
```

samir: Add a short bench note showing med/p95 for GPU vs CPU fallback for a 512-token job so teams understand the impact.

maria: Done: GPU med 48ms p95 82ms; CPU fallback med 210ms p95 430ms. Also added sequence_limit: 4096 and a note that long sequences worsen the CPU penalty.

kevin: One-line migration tip for Dedicated: ensure pinned GPU pools have updated kernels or schedule rolling upgrades.

maria: Added a Dedicated migration checklist. Fixed stale link /models/stratus -> /catalog/stratus6b and added a changelog entry.

docs-bot: New PR opened by maria: #507  reviewers requested: @kevin @ara @samir

ara: Style nit: use sentence case for headings and keep the snippet under a single code block.

maria: Updated style and trimmed snippet. Will squash bench commits after final review.

kevin: I'll review bench methodology in the morning.

samir: I'll proof the compat paragraph this afternoon.

maria: Thanks everyone. After merge I'll ping support and the Dedicated runbook owners to propagate the change.

(END)
